title: Saving per public-cost unit
hook: Two stated cases: explore net saving after a stated program cost.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How net saving after a stated program cost affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Saving, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare net saving after a stated program cost in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
